name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal-forced~p2
task: Taking the key means you must open the door too.
texts: If the agent ever has the door key, it must eventually open the door.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, door_open) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u0) -> 1
